data: Which line is positioned closer to the zero value in the right plot?

The question asks which line is positioned closer to the zero value in the right plot. From the caption, we know that the cosine similarity between the gradients issued from LINT and LCEpretrain is being measured. The lines in the right plot represent two different models, S2P and SSI. 

Looking at the right plot, the blue line (S2P) appears to be positioned closer to the zero value compared to the orange line (SSI). This can be observed by noting the y-axis values for both lines. The blue line (S2P) stays within a range closer to zero than the orange line (SSI), which shows more variation and is further away from zero. Therefore, the blue line (S2P) is positioned closer to the zero value.
